name: Liliana Vess
text: [+1]: Target player discards a card.\n[−2]: Search your library for a card, then shuffle and put that card on top.\n[−8]: Put all creature cards from all graveyards onto the battlefield under your control.
rulings: [{'date': '2009-10-01', 'text': 'A “creature card” is any card with the type creature, even if it has other types such as artifact, enchantment, or land. Older cards of type summon are also creature cards.'}]

name: Nissa Revane
text: [+1]: Search your library for a card named Nissa's Chosen, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.\n[+1]: You gain 2 life for each Elf you control.\n[−7]: Search your library for any number of Elf creature cards, put them onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
rulings: [{'date': '2009-10-01', 'text': 'You may activate Nissa’s first ability even if you know you have no cards named Nissa’s Chosen in your library. You must still shuffle your library in that situation.'}, {'date': '2009-10-01', 'text': 'You may activate Nissa’s second ability even if you control no Elves.'}]
